preconditions.description: Input is a single line with three space-separated integers n, k, d.

postconditions.expression: count_paths(n, k, d) == sum(1 for path in all_paths(n, k) if any(edge >= d for edge in path))
postconditions.description: count_paths(n, k, d) is the count of all paths from root to any node with total weight n, where at least one edge in the path has weight ≥ d.

postconditions.expression: all_paths(n, k) == {tuple(path) for path in generate_paths(n, k)}
postconditions.description: all_paths(n, k) is the set of all paths from root to any node with total weight n, where each path is a tuple of edge weights (1..k) summing to n.
generate_paths(n, k) generates all paths from root to any node with total weight n, where each path is a list of edge weights (1..k) summing to n.

postconditions.expression: generate_paths_recursive(n, k, path, current_sum) == [] if current_sum > n else [path] if current_sum == n else sum([generate_paths_recursive(n, k, path + [w], current_sum + w) for w in range(1, k+1)], [])
postconditions.description: generate_paths_recursive(n, k, path, current_sum) recursively generates all paths with total weight n by appending edge weights 1..k.
